examples.message: Is 1.62 USD fair for 5000 kg of MAT-0001 from V-0002 on 2025-06-15?
examples.answer:
The price of 1.62 USD for 5,000 kg of MAT-0001 from V-0002 is OVERPRICED.

The quoted price is 15.7% above the should-cost of 1.4000 USD (range 1.3071 to 1.4664). This exceeds our flag threshold of 12%. Negotiating to the should-cost could result in a potential saving of 1,100.14 USD.

For context, the market index for steel_hrc has decreased by 8.2% over the last 3 months and 2.5% over the last 12 months. While V-0002 (Siam Supply Co., Ltd.) has an on-time rate of 91%, they are typically priced 6.9% above should-cost. Recent purchases of this material from other vendors ranged from 1.3581 USD to 1.5420 USD.

I recommend requesting a negotiation playbook to help bring this price down.
